title: Update the select fallback button text when descendants change
body: The select fallback button text was only set when the user changed the selection, and used the label IDL attribute of the selected option. It now also updates when option elements are inserted, moved, or removed, and when the label of the selected option changes, using the new descendant changed steps and descendant moved steps of the DOM Standard. Attribute change steps signal a descendant change for changes to the label attribute of an option element and the alt attribute of an img element. It also uses the label options are rendered with, which falls back to the option's text when its label attribute is the empty string and includes the alt attribute of img descendants.
